title: U.S. House · Ohio's 14th District
area: Northeast Ohio, including Lake, Geauga and Ashtabula counties and part of eastern Cuyahoga County.

context.text: Incumbent David Joyce (R) defeated Nicole Frenchko in the May 5, 2026 Republican primary. Maria Jukic (D) defeated Bill O'Neill and Carl Setzer in the Democratic primary.

summary.text: David Joyce is the Republican incumbent seeking re-election in Ohio's 14th Congressional District, which he has represented since 2013. He chairs the House Appropriations Subcommittee on Financial Services and General Government.

positions.summary: In January 2026 he said he voted for a three-year extension of the ACA enhanced premium tax credits as short-term relief, while calling a clean extension not a solution to a flawed system.
positions.quote: I supported this legislation to make clear that Congress cannot ignore the consequences of the credits’ expiration and to force a real conversation about responsible, short-term relief paired with meaningful reforms.

record.text: Chairs the House Appropriations Subcommittee on Financial Services and General Government (119th Congress, 2025-2026), also sitting on the Defense subcommittee.
Served as ranking member of the Appropriations Subcommittee on Interior, Environment, and Related Agencies and on the House Committee on Ethics in the 117th Congress (2021-2022).

summary.text: Maria Jukic is the Democratic nominee for Ohio's 14th Congressional District. She is an attorney and small-business owner.

background.text: Earned a high school diploma from Villa Angela Academy, a bachelor's degree from the University of Notre Dame, a graduate degree from John Carroll University, and a law degree from Cleveland State University College of Law.
Works as an attorney and small-business owner.

positions.summary: Her campaign site supports lowering the Medicare eligibility age to 62 and says the U.S. must ultimately guarantee universal healthcare.
positions.quote: Maria believes the United States must ultimately join every other high-income nation in guaranteeing universal healthcare.

positions.summary: Her campaign site says ICE must be reined in, retrained and restructured, and criticizes the administration's mass deportation campaign.
positions.quote: ICE must be reined in, retrained, and restructured. Enforcement must be targeted, lawful, and humane.

positions.summary: Her campaign site supports closing the carried interest loophole, taxing investment income at rates comparable to work, and ending corporate tax avoidance.
positions.quote: Maria supports closing those loopholes, cracking down on offshore tax shelters, and making sure corporations that profit from American workers and infrastructure actually pay their fair share.

positions.summary: Her campaign site opposes the administration's tariffs as a hidden tax and says they are imposed without congressional approval.
positions.quote: Tariffs raise prices on goods that ordinary people buy every day, from groceries to appliances to clothing.

positions.summary: Her campaign site supports significant federal investment in clean energy and an energy strategy that aggressively expands clean energy while managing the transition away from fossil fuels.
positions.quote: She supports a responsible all-of-the-above energy strategy that aggressively expands clean energy while managing the transition away from fossil fuels in a way that protects workers, keeps energy affordable, and maintains grid reliability.

positions.summary: Her campaign site supports raising the federal minimum wage.
positions.quote: Maria also supports raising the federal minimum wage
